question.question: For The Aid of Morgana, Swift Strike, Gaze of Stone, Winged Frenzy, and all seven original Sinbad Voyage cards, state permitted fighter(s) and whether each is attack only, defense only, versatile, or scheme. Can Merlin defend with Swift Strike or Morgana? Can a Harpy initiate Winged Frenzy or Gaze? Can Porter attack with a Voyage, or Sinbad defend with one?

fixed_key.expected_answer: The Aid of Morgana: Arthur only, attack only; Swift Strike: ANY own fighter, attack only; Merlin may attack with it but cannot defend with it; Gaze of Stone: Medusa only, attack only; Winged Frenzy: ANY own fighter, scheme; a Harpy may initiate it; All seven Voyages: Sinbad only, attack only; Merlin cannot defend with Morgana (wrong fighter and attack-only); A Harpy cannot initiate Gaze (Medusa-only); Porter cannot attack with Voyage (Sinbad-only); Sinbad cannot defend with Voyage (attack-only)
required_facts: The Aid of Morgana: Arthur only, attack only
Swift Strike: ANY own fighter, attack only; Merlin may attack with it but cannot defend with it
Gaze of Stone: Medusa only, attack only
Winged Frenzy: ANY own fighter, scheme; a Harpy may initiate it
All seven Voyages: Sinbad only, attack only
Merlin cannot defend with Morgana (wrong fighter and attack-only)
Porter cannot attack with Voyage (Sinbad-only); Sinbad cannot defend with Voyage (attack-only)

raw_reader_entry.answer: Aid the Chosen One: Merlin attack only. Swift Strike: ANY attack only. Gaze of Stone: Medusa attack only. Winged Frenzy: ANY scheme, Medusa or surviving Harpy may initiate. All seven Voyages are Sinbad-only attack cards. Merlin cannot defend with Swift Strike or Aid the Chosen One. Harpy cannot initiate Gaze of Stone; Harpy can initiate Winged Frenzy. Porter cannot attack with a Voyage; Sinbad cannot defend with one.

#### King Arthur (remaining 18 cards)

|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Noble Sacrifice | King Arthur | Attack only | 2 | 3 | 3 | During combat you **may BOOST this attack**, in addition to any BOOST from Arthur’s ability. Discard a hand card and add its BOOST value. |
| Excalibur | King Arthur | Attack only | 6 | 3 | 1 | No printed effect. |
| The Aid of Morgana | King Arthur | Attack only | 4 | 2 | 1 | After combat draw 2 cards. |

| The Holy Grail | King Arthur | Defense only | 1 | 2 | 1 | After combat, if Arthur has **4 or less health but is not defeated**, set his health to **8**. At 5+ nothing happens; at 0 the duel has already ended. |
| The Lady of the Lake | King Arthur | Scheme | — | 2 | 1 | Search your deck and discard pile for **Excalibur** and add it to hand. **If you searched your deck, shuffle it.** |
| Prophecy | Merlin | Scheme | — | 2 | 1 | Look at top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 to hand and put the other 2 back on top in **any order**. |
| Bewilderment | Merlin | Defense only | 0 | 2 | 2 | During combat prevent **all damage**. After combat you **may place Merlin in any space** (unoccupied). |
| Aid the Chosen One | Merlin | Attack only | 4 | 2 | 1 | After combat, if you won, draw 2 cards. |
| Restless Spirits | Merlin | Scheme | — | 2 | 1 | Choose any space **in Merlin’s zone**. Deal 2 damage to each opposing fighter in that space **and in one adjacent space**. If at least one fighter is defeated this way, draw **1 card**, not one per defeat. |
| Command the Storms | Merlin | Scheme | — | 2 | 2 | Move **each fighter**, including opposing fighters, up to 3 spaces. For opposing fighters use movement rules from their owner’s perspective. |
| Swift Strike | ANY | Attack only | 3 | 2 | 2 | After combat move **your fighting fighter** up to 4 spaces. |

#### Sinbad (remaining 21 nonshared cards)

All **7 Voyage** cards are **Sinbad-only attack cards, printed combat value 2, one copy each**. **Voyage Home has BOOST 1; the other six have no printed BOOST value.** Each has: **during combat, add 1 value for every Voyage card already in your discard pile**. Thus the normal value is **2 + that existing pile count**; exclude only the card currently being played because it is not in discard yet. **Three already-discarded Voyages give value 5.** Their separate after-combat effects are below; they **do not require winning** unless an effect explicitly says so.

| Voyage | After combat (only while the duel continues) |
|---|---|
| Voyage Home | Take all **other Voyage cards from your discard pile into hand**. Then Home itself goes to discard at the normal end of combat. The retrieved cards leave the pile, but **Home remains there**: with Home alone in discard, each fighter’s next unboosted maneuver allowance is **2 + 1 = 3**, not 2. |
| Voyage to the Island That Was a Whale | Sinbad recovers 2 health. |
| Voyage to the Valley of the Giant Snakes | Look at opponent’s hand. |
| Voyage to the Creature with Eyes Like Coals of Fire | Opponent discards **1 random card**. |
| Voyage to the Cannibals with the Root of Madness | You **may move Sinbad up to 2 spaces**. |
| Voyage to the City of the Man-Eating Apes | Deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter. |
| Voyage to the City of the King of Serendib | Draw 1 card. |
